words.trans: 短语：对……感到厌烦；受够了（haven't you had enough of...? = 你还没折腾够吗）
examples: What on earth are you doing now? Haven't you had enough of all that?

words.trans: adv. 不必要地，多此一举地
examples: Maggie gestured needlessly towards the open door.

words.trans: 短语：做了个多余的手势（手势其实没必要做——门本来就开着）
examples: Maggie gestured needlessly towards the open door from where there was a sudden squawking from the magpies across the lawn.

words.trans: 固定表达：咬紧牙关（clench = 咬紧/攥紧）
examples: 'Gotcha!' he said at last, through clenched teeth.

words.trans: 固定表达：咬紧牙关地（说话），形容人紧张、恼火或强忍情绪时挤话出口
examples: 'Gotcha!' he said at last, through clenched teeth.

words.trans: n. 船尾甲板（aft = 在船尾）
examples: Twenty minutes later they were all gathered on the aft deck of Matilda.

words.trans: n. 夹子、钳子（烧烤夹）；英语中常用复数形式 tongs（像 scissors/trousers 一样成对存在）
examples: Jim pointed with a pair of tongs to a basket on the roof of the cabin.

words.trans: n. 小圆面包、餐包（不是动词'滚动'！复数 rolls 指一篮子汉堡用的面包）
examples: Here, Maggie, if you bring me those rolls, you can help me put them in.

words.trans: 句式：if you bring me those rolls, you can help me... 这里的 if 不是真实的'条件/因果'（不是：你不拿来就绝对不许帮忙），而是英语口语里常见的提议式 if，不是逻辑条件，是分工邀约——'（要是）你负责把餐包拿过来，那接下来咱们就能一起把它们装进篮子'。本质是把同一件活儿拆成两步：①把 rolls 取来 + ②把 rolls 放进篮子
examples: Here, Maggie, if you bring me those rolls, you can help me put them in.

words.trans: n.（船、游艇上的）厨房
examples: Tom scrambled down to the galley to fetch some glasses.

words.trans: n. 榛木；榛树（hazel 木质地轻韧，适合做手杖）
examples: He'd cut a length of hazel from a tree at the edge of the garden to replace his stick which had been lost in the aqueduct.

words.trans: 短语：对……小题大做；大肆吹捧/大肆夸赞（make a fuss of sb 把某人当成英雄一样大张旗鼓地夸）
examples: He hoped Jim was not going to make a fuss of him.

words.trans: n. 正常状态（return to normality 回归正常生活）
examples: So far he had been thankful that the return to normality had been exactly that.

words.trans: v. 眨一只眼；使眼色（wink at sb 冲某人挤眼暗示）
examples: When he came back on deck Jim looked at him and winked.

words.word: from the comfort of + 地点
words.trans: 这是英语里很常用的固定句式，不是单纯名词 comfort。from the comfort of (some place) = 不用跑到外面去折腾，舒舒服服待在这个地方就能做成某事（带一点调侃：足不出户却干成了大事）
examples: 'All from the comfort of his workshop,' said Maggie, smiling at Tom.
words.key: from the comfort of + 地点

words.trans: 短语：到湖里去了，远离湖岸，在开阔水域那边（out 强调'远离岸边、到了开阔处'）
examples: Out on the lake the Teal was curving through a junior boat race.

words.trans: n.（帆船的）大三角帆、球形帆（顺风时张开鼓满风的那面大帆）
examples: ...spinnakers ballooning as a dozen mirror dinghies rounded a buoy.

words.trans: v. 膨胀、鼓起来（此处动词，指船帆张开鼓满风；不是名词'气球'）
examples: ...spinnakers ballooning as a dozen mirror dinghies rounded a buoy.

words.trans: n. Mirror 型小艇（Mirror 是船型名字，不是'镜子小艇'！背景：Mirror 是英国经典的青少年比赛用小帆船，当年由《Daily Mirror 每日镜报》赞助推出，故名 Mirror，英式湖区少年帆船赛里特别常见，正匹配文中 junior boat race）
examples: ...spinnakers ballooning as a dozen mirror dinghies rounded a buoy and started tacking downwind.

words.trans: 短语：绕过浮标（帆船比赛术语'绕标'，round 此处作动词'绕过'）——比赛赛道用浮标当拐点，船要沿规定方向贴着浮标绕过去才算完成这一程。不是'放浮标'，浮标早固定在水里了
examples: ...a dozen mirror dinghies rounded a buoy and started tacking downwind.

words.trans: 短语：下风侧连续换舷（downwind 顺风方向；tacking downwind 是顺风时来回换舷抢航，不是普通逆风抢风）
examples: ...a dozen mirror dinghies rounded a buoy and started tacking downwind.

words.trans: n. 浮标、航标
examples: ...a dozen mirror dinghies rounded a buoy and started tacking downwind.

words.trans: v.（帆船）抢风航行、调转风向行驶（船不能直直顺风走，需走'之'字形不断转向）
examples: ...and started tacking downwind.

words.trans: 短语：到这会儿为止、如今（强调时间推移的结果——到当下这个时间点，事情已发生、信息已传到他们耳朵里）。日常口语里 by now 常带一层'我预期/推断'的味道：按时间推算按理说到现在应该已经发生了，我不一定亲眼确认
examples: They all knew by now about his traumatic escape.

words.trans: adj. 造成精神创伤的、痛苦难忘的
examples: They all knew by now about his traumatic escape through the tunnel of his own worst nightmares.

words.trans: smile at = 对着……微笑、为某事露出微笑（常常是对某件事/某种局面心生感慨、莞尔一笑）
examples: ...he found himself smiling at the way things had worked out.

words.trans: 句式：smile / marvel / be shocked + at + the way... 其中 the way 是名词宾语，at 是动词的介词，意思是对【这样一种情形/样子】产生情绪反应（惊叹、微笑、生气等），the way 后接定语从句把情形说清楚。例：He was angry at the way she ignored him. 这个结构在小说里超高频：smile at the way... / marvel at the way... / be shocked at the way...
examples: And with some surprise, he found himself smiling at the way things had worked out.

words.trans: 短语：不知不觉就……；发现自己正在（做某事）——强调没刻意计划却已然如此
examples: ...he found himself smiling at the way things had worked out.

words.trans: = think whatever it liked：让世人想什么都行、世人爱怎么想就怎么想（liked 是过去式表虚拟，'爱怎么…就怎么'）
examples: Let the world think what it liked about him and Snakey.

words.trans: 短语：对某人持有某种看法（think what... about sb = 关于某人心里的想法是……）
examples: Let the world think what it liked about him and Snakey.

words.trans: n. 走狗、爪牙、小跟班（多带贬义，指替坏人办事的手下）
examples: Snakey only ever had minions, and he'd lost those too now.

words.trans: 短语：算不上真正意义上的、不完全、没做到位
examples: 'We haven't caught them, though,' stated Joel. 'Not properly.'

words.trans: 习语：做坏事而逃脱惩罚、逍遥法外（get away with sth 侥幸逃脱）
examples: It sounds like they'll get away with it after all!

words.trans: 固定习语：将……绳之以法、使某人受到法律制裁（bring sb to justice）
examples: Containing enough photographic evidence to bring the whole gang to justice.

words.trans: 用法：'It wasn't, though, was it?' 这里 though 放在逗号之间（..., though, ...），是口语/小说对话常见的插入式写法 = 不过、可是、话说回来。它不是句首 though 也不是句末 though，插在句子中间带来轻微转折，用来缓和语气、引入相反视角。把 though 塞在主谓语之间，是副词 though（和句末那个是同一个词），打断句子带出停顿：'话说回来、可其实'，转折力度不强，不是强对立，只是换个角度看这事
examples: 'It wasn't, though, was it?' said Maggie.

words.trans: 短语：追查出来、追踪找到；（经过一番搜寻、调查之后）终于找到
examples: If they hadn't tracked us down at the tarn, we would have slept peacefully through the night.

words.trans: 习语：事物的总体格局、大千世界的整体事态（the big scheme of things 宏大的整体安排）
examples: Even old Snakey had a purpose in the big scheme of things.

words.trans: 短语：站起身来（= stand up，但更强调'起身'这个动作过程）
examples: Tom got to his feet now and coughed as if he were about to perform a magic trick.

words.trans: n. 钳子、夹子（文中 robotic pincers = 机器夹爪，像螃蟹钳一样的抓取装置，常用复数 pincers）
examples: I made some simple robotic pincers and sent Skylark up.

words.trans: n. 雪松、西洋杉
examples: You get so used to them squawking in the cedars, you forget they are there at all.

words.trans: 语法：after which 引导非限定定语从句，which 指代前面整件事（这里指 laughter and applause 笑声和掌声这件事）——'在这之后，Jim 又端上第二轮汉堡'
examples: This was followed by laughter and applause, after which Jim served a second round of burgers and Tom topped up everyone's drinks.

words.trans: adj. 锯齿状的（serrated edges of the high fells = 山脊线如锯齿般参差起伏）
examples: ...looked out to where the sky met the serrated edges of the high fells.

words.trans: n. 舰旗、船旗；军旗。这里指船上悬挂的旗帜。red ensign：红底旗帜，是英国民用船只的船旗
examples: ...the red ensign on the stern of Matilda snapped in the clean bright air.

words.trans: v. 反弹、回响；弹射开来（引擎轰鸣声在山壁间来回反弹、回荡）
examples: ...the surge of their engines ricocheting from the mountain walls and filling the air.

words.trans: n. 菱形编队（飞行表演术语，九架飞机排成菱形队形）
examples: ...the planes tilted on to their sides and formed a perfect diamond.

words.trans: n. 马蹄形；U 形物（horseshoe of fells = 环抱如马蹄形的山峦）
examples: ...disappeared over the horseshoe of fells to the north for a moment.

words.trans: v. 螺旋式盘旋飞行（像开瓶钻一样螺旋前进、边转边移动）
examples: ...roaring over their heads, corkscrewing south, red, white and blue smoke trails drifting over the water.

words.trans: v. 逐渐变小、减弱；降低；（贬低某人）贬低（diminishing dots = 越飞越远越来越小的飞机光点）
examples: ...all eyes followed the diminishing dots as they passed over the islands.

words.trans: n. 一致、齐声。in unison（最常用固定搭配）= 一齐、同步、异口同声（字面'同一个音调'，引申大家一起做同一件事）
examples: Heads moved in unison with the jets as they formed a new shape.

words.trans: n.（飞行）筋斗、翻圈动作（飞机在垂直面内画一个完整圆圈）
examples: 'Blackbird loop,' said Tom.

words.trans: n. 旋转木马；这里是特技动作名字'木马对冲'——两架飞机看似相距仅几英尺迎面交错掠过
examples: 'Carousel,' said Tom, as two planes passed each other at what looked like a few feet apart.

words.trans: 短语：香槟开花（特技名字，虚构命名）。解释：飞机垂直向上冲顶，然后向四面八方散开，像开香槟时泡沫四散炸开
examples: 'Champagne split,' he explained as the jets hammered up to vertical, then down and split in all directions.

words.trans: n. 倒飞桶滚（inverted 倒扣着飞 + barrel roll 桶滚：机身沿轴翻滚）飞行特技
examples: Two of them fly an inverted barrel roll with three others in formation.

words.trans: n. 负重力、负 G 力（航空术语，失重类过载——飞行员会感到身体被往上'抛'出座椅，非常难受）
examples: The minus G will be terrible in there.

words.trans: 短语：绝佳位置、黄金位置（prime = 最好的、首要的）
examples: The houseboat was in prime position for the display.

words.trans: v.（物体）上下快速轻轻晃动、起伏颠簸。解释：一般指浮在水面上的东西随水波一上一下
examples: Out on the lake, yachts bobbed about, their sails flapping as every eye looked skyward.

words.trans: 短语：心与矛（特技拉烟造型名称，红箭飞行表演经典动作）。解释：两架飞机拉烟画出一个爱心 heart；第三架拖着烟高速穿过爱心，像一支长矛 spear 刺穿它，故名 heart and spear
examples: They're getting ready for the heart and spear.

words.trans: n. 半筋斗、半圈翻转（半个 loop，飞机翻转半圈改变航向）
examples: Two of them will do a half-loop with smoke to form a heart.

words.trans: 固定短语：用手遮挡眼睛（挡阳光）（shade 作动词，用掌心在额前搭凉棚）
examples: Everyone on the deck of Matilda had their hands on their foreheads to shade their eyes from the sun.

words.trans: adj. 散开的、分散的（disperse 分散、四散）
examples: Eight of the Red Arrows had dispersed over the mountains.

words.trans: 短语：吸收、吸纳（像海绵吸水一样；文中天空像海绵一样吸走最后几缕烟）
examples: Tom caught Maggie's eye and they watched the sky soak up the last wisps of smoke like a sponge.
